nodes.summary: For a type $\alpha$ with a primitive recursive encoding, a function $e$ assigning to each natural number $n$ either an element $e(n)$ of $\alpha$ or nothing enumerates a predicate $p$ on $\alpha$ when, for every $a \in \alpha$, $p(a)$ holds if and only if $e(n) = a$ for some natural number $n$.
nodes.title: Enumerating a predicate

nodes.summary: For every type $\alpha$ with a primitive recursive encoding and every predicate $p$ on $\alpha$ that is recognizable by a multi-stack machine, there is a computable function $e$, assigning to each natural number either an element of $\alpha$ or nothing, that enumerates $p$.
nodes.title: Recognizable languages are enumerable

nodes.summary: For every type $\alpha$ with a primitive recursive encoding, a predicate $p$ on $\alpha$ is recognizable by a multi-stack machine if and only if some computable function $e$, assigning to each natural number either an element of $\alpha$ or nothing, enumerates $p$. This is Sipser, Theorem 3.21: a language is Turing-recognizable if and only if some enumerator enumerates it.
nodes.title: Recognizable languages are exactly the enumerable ones

nodes.summary: For every type $\alpha$ with a primitive recursive encoding, every predicate $p$ on $\alpha$ and every computable function $e$, assigning to each natural number either an element of $\alpha$ or nothing, that enumerates $p$, the predicate $p$ is recognizable by a multi-stack machine.
nodes.title: Enumerable languages are recognizable

can_prove.label: ready to prove
can_prove.meaning: Statement is in Lean and nothing it needs is blocked, so the proof can start.

can_state.label: ready to state
can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
